occluded-content.description: An element covers or hides another, more important one.

content-overflow.description: Text or content runs past its container.

off-canvas.description: An element sits partly or wholly outside the visible slide.

misaligned-elements.description: Elements that should share an edge or axis do not.

unbalanced-margins.description: Margins are uneven, cramped or inconsistent across slides.

cluttered-layout.description: Too many elements for the space or the message.

sparse-layout.description: A region is mostly dead space; the content does not use it.

lack-of-hierarchy.description: No clear focal point; importance is not shown by salience.

distant-annotation.description: A label, quote or callout sits far from what it refers to.

unstable-placement.description: A shared element jumps or rescales between slides.

misaligned-arrowhead.description: An arrowhead is skewed or offset from its line's end.

inconsistent-text-styling.description: Fonts, sizes or text treatments vary without meaning.

inappropriate-font-sizing.description: Text too small for the viewing conditions.

illegible-text.description: Text that compression, size or contrast makes hard to read.

awkward-line-break.description: An orphan word or a term split across lines.

insufficient-contrast.description: Text or marks below the contrast threshold.

mismatched-colours.description: Colours that clash, glare or do not belong together.

role-misuse.description: A colour used outside its declared semantic role.

hardcoded-colour.description: A raw colour value outside the theme, blocking palette swaps.

branded-palette.description: Colours or tokens named or branded after an organisation.

decorative-visual.description: A visual that illustrates the topic but carries no evidence.

missing-alt-text.description: A meaningful non-text element without alt text or a name.

distracting-animation.description: Motion that loops, marches or reveals on a timer where it should not.

restated-steps.description: Step text or builds that duplicate what the visual already shows.

unreachable-step.description: A slide or step that navigation cannot reach or that renders inconsistently.

multiple-messages.description: A slide or step that carries more than one message.

topic-title.description: A title that labels a topic instead of stating a finding.

excessive-text-density.description: More words on the slide than the deck type allows.

weak-arc.description: Slides that do not build an argument in order.

missing-takeaway.description: A close that does not say what the audience should do or remember.

missing-note.description: A content slide without a reader note.

vague-ask.description: An ask, decision or next step without specifics, owner or date.

unlabelled-chart.description: A chart without axis labels, units, scale or baseline.

dequantified-claim.description: A figure or encoding without values, comparison or context.

buried-status.description: Status or the decision needed sits below the detail.

unsourced-claim.description: A factual claim without a cited source.

overclaim.description: A claim that goes beyond what its source supports.

altered-quote.description: A quotation that is not verbatim or not attributed.

unflagged-dispute.description: A disputed or single-sourced claim stated as settled.

broken-link.description: A citation without a real, well-formed hyperlink.

missing-denominator.description: A number whose unit or base population is unclear.

hook-title.description: A title written as a hook, teaser, pun or rhetorical question.

aphorism.description: Antithesis, chiasmus or an epigram closer.

imprecise-vocabulary.description: Metaphor or wording that names the wrong actor or action.

generic-ai-prose.description: Copy that reads as generic AI writing rather than the presenter's.

cut-to-fit.description: Approved meaning removed to make text fit the layout.

generic-question.description: A discussion prompt that would fit any talk.

title-form.description: A title with several sentences, a trailing stop or decorative italics.

overlong-overlay.description: An overlay longer than the voice profile allows.

external-dependency.description: A resource fetched from outside the file at view time.

endpoint-risk.description: A code pattern likely to trip endpoint-security heuristics.

per-slide-styling.description: Styles or scripts defined inside one slide instead of once.

duplicate-title.description: Two slides sharing a title, or a slide without one.

reading-order.description: DOM order that differs from visual reading order.

undocumented-contract.description: An attribute, class or state the contract does not document.

rasterised-text.description: Text exported as part of a picture, so it cannot be edited.

missing-placeholder.description: A slide off the master layouts or with text outside placeholders.

literal-colour.description: A literal colour or font where a theme slot exists.

missing-animation.description: A build step lost or carried by Morph where a native animation exists.

undeclared-effect.description: An effect with no native/approximated/lost declaration, or one exported unlike it.

wrap-drift.description: Text wraps differently from the HTML, changing the layout.

accessibility-error.description: An error in the PowerPoint accessibility checker.

flattened-diagram.description: A diagram exported only as a bitmap.

missing-notes.description: Speaker notes missing or not matching the reader note.

green-before-red.description: Implementation committed before its failing tests.

false-red.description: A red commit whose tests do not fail for the real reason.

stale-docs.description: Docs or index rows not updated with the change they describe.

unlooked-screenshots.description: Visual work called done without looking at the assembled deck.

unverified-done.description: A done claim the diff or tests do not bear out.

multi-question.description: The presenter was asked several questions at once or given a picker.

research-without-consent.description: Research done without the presenter's recorded consent.

skipped-prototype.description: New visual language built with no prototype or recorded in-situ choice.

disabled-guard.description: Layout checks turned off or skipped to get past a fault.

code-before-intent.description: Code changed ahead of the requirements or spec governing it.
